summary: ICL Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine supply agreement with Indian Potash Limited (IPL) for 375,000 metric tons of potash (plus an option for an additional 50,000 metric tons) at $383 per ton CIFFO Indian ports, under an existing five-year framework agreement (2022-2027). This is a standard commercial contract, not a special situation. No deal consideration, shareholder vote, or board recommendation is involved. The filing is a foreign private issuer's current report of ordinary business operations. No risk-arb or special-situation angle exists.
